notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Critical Bugs[/h3]

[*] Fixed Blue Whale-class combination bug

[/list]

notes.title: Day One Patch
notes.content:
We will release an update on the first day to fix bugs in the game.

[h2]Fix Critical Bug[/h2]

Stage 4: Unable to resupply ammunition

[h2]Fix Other Bugs[/h2]

Stage 2: Added a scene door to prevent players from entering the back area without triggering the event

All objective markers are now displayed on the minimap

Weapon description errors

notes.title: DEMO Updated Again!
notes.content:
[h1]To All Commanders:[/h1]

We have always been listening to your voices, and we know you've been waiting anxiously. Therefore, we decided to update the DEMO again to let everyone experience the new content of Star Ash Fleet.

[h2]Overdrive Mode[/h2]

Many players have told us that frontline rules limited their performance. Really? Let's have a free-for-all then!
We've added a new gameplay mode - Overdrive Mode - to certain story chapters. Now we invite you to preview it in the DEMO.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45293807/6aad26d697c67e9b7d2c856f4ea2dfb1f57da09e.png[/img]
[list]
[*] No Frontlines
[*] Fleets gain all buffs from both Attack and Defense modes simultaneously
[*] Warships automatically target enemies
[/list]
[b]Then face waves of enemies![/b]

Update your DEMO now to experience the latest content.

Additionally, you might not know: We've just revealed the cruisers in the game. Although the DEMO doesn't include gameplay for these super warships, look forward to commanding them in the official release.

[previewyoutube=PcAw5D8kY3I;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











Redonleft
